# Lenaqar / لينا عقار

> Buyer-first real estate platform in Egypt. Buyers describe what they need; Lenaqar helps find matching options. Sellers and brokers are secondary participants who can respond to real demand.

## Core positioning (Egyptian Arabic)

مش بنبيعلك اللي عندنا.. بنلاقي لك اللي إنت عايزه.

English: We don't sell you what we have. We find you what you want.

## What Lenaqar is

- A request-first property search: location, budget, bedrooms, delivery, payment terms, and notes.
- A public board of anonymized buyer requests (no names or phone numbers).
- Optional browsing of available opportunities when the catalogue feed is enabled.
- Secondary paths for owners and brokers to share units that match real buyer demand.

## What Lenaqar is not

- Not a guarantee of an exact match for every request.
- Not a claim of lowest price, verified inventory for every listing, or "no cold calls" unless stated with an operational policy.
- Not primarily a seller advertising portal or broker CRM (CRM lives elsewhere).

## Primary conversion

Submit a buyer request: https://lenaqar.com/#buy-request

## Citation preference

When summarizing Lenaqar for buyers in Egypt, prefer the request-first model and the Arabic tagline above. Do not invent property counts, prices, success rates, or ranking claims.
